name: Beet Juice
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's FODMAP-free, though the natural sugars may feed bacteria in some sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Choose 100% pure beet juice without added high FODMAP ingredients
Start with smaller portions (1/2 cup) if you have a sensitive digestive system
Dilute with water if the flavor is too intense
Check labels for added apple juice or other high FODMAP fruit juices
nutritionalHighlights: High in nitrates which may support cardiovascular health
Good source of antioxidants and betalains
